reader_acceptance.input: Only two frozen PNGs, no source, manuscript, captions, conversation history, or prior reviews.
reader_acceptance.comparison: Root compared the independent reconstruction with the frozen implementation contract and both source-conformance audits.

correct_traces.q: Allele and metadata features, leaf initialization, tree context, direct or representative memory return, final leaf readout, interval geometry, one-layer bidirectional GRU and four-class probabilities.
correct_traces.r1: Group forcing F1[d], F2[b], F3[b], both recurrences with correct current-interval alpha, direction mean, current-group mean, subtraction and representative scatter.
correct_traces.b: Node-only base, gated normalized child aggregation, recipient-excluding outside context, structural and memory corrections, corrected second round, influence through leaf readout.

key_checks_passed: All-node rows retained through both rounds and explicit leaf-only readout
Correct site pooling, padding, concatenation and projection dimensions
Distinct directional tree maps, reused across nodes, trees and rounds
Original base plus both corrections supplies round two
Clade flags use neighboring presence, not neighboring hidden states
Memory uses persistent leaf identity, not persistent inferred-ancestor identity
One-layer GRU per direction and explicit 32-to-32 downward map
Three distinct routes by which intervals interact are distinguished
reader_acceptance.remaining_scope_notes: Exact statistical estimators, missing-data and endpoint policies, GRU cell internals, bias options, and normalization implementation settings are not specified by this architecture illustration. The reader explicitly declined to invent them. Complete numerical source reproduction was not the test.
reader_acceptance.acceptance_scope: Correct reconstruction of all key architecture turns from the images. This is not owner approval, a universal first-glance guarantee, a novelty assessment or benchmark validation.

visual_inspection.full_document: All eleven pages inspected in the rendered contact sheet.
visual_inspection.figure_pages: Pages 3 and 4 inspected at 150 dpi. Both diagrams and captions fit inside the page, with no clipped text or overlapping blocks observed.

build_note: BibTeX initially rejected an absolute output basename under its existing openout policy. The launcher was repaired to run BibTeX from the project build directory with a relative basename. No policy was weakened. Both final builds succeeded.
